rows.text: How do I start a new student club? We want to create a robotics club.
rows.reply: To start a new student club, you need at least fifteen founding students. Your club advisor must send the application along with the required documents to the SKS office by the last day of October or February each year. The required documents include the Club Founding Petition Form (EK-1), Club Statute (EK-2), current student certificates of the founding students, and documents showing they have no disciplinary penalty. Please keep in mind that applications submitted outside of October or February, or with missing documents, will be considered invalid. (Source: BŞEÜ Öğrenci Kulüpleri Yönergesi (Senate decision 30.06.2021, 295/8), Articles 7, 8)
